title: North Korea to consider shutting down Swiss diplomatic office in Pyongyang, KCNA says
html:
Kim Yo Jong, sister of North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un, said Swiss sanctions have infringed on the country’s sovereignty and demonstrate hostility towards Pyongyang.

PHOTO: REUTERS

SEOUL – North Korea condemned Switzerland on Nov 24 for sanctioning a North Korean children’s camp over the transfer of children from Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine and said it would consider shutting down the Swiss diplomatic office in Pyongyang, state media said.

North Korean leader Kim Jong Un’s influential sister, Kim Yo Jong, said the Swiss sanctions are an act that infringes on the country’s sovereignty and demonstrates hostility towards Pyongyang, the KCNA state news agency reported.

Voice of America reported in November that Switzerland had added North Korea’s Songdowon International Children’s Camp to its sanctions list for cooperating with Russia-linked groups to transfer children from Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine.

Reuters could not immediately confirm the Swiss measure.

The sanctions deny North Korea’s obligation to provide all children with opportunities of culture and recreation and leave “an indelible stain” on its international reputation as a country that promotes humanitarianism, Kim Yo Jong said in a statement.

“I deem it necessary to comprehensively reconsider the relations with unreliable Switzerland, whose deeds do not agree with its words,” Kim was quoted as saying by KCNA.

“I will advise our Foreign Ministry to strictly examine the issue of withdrawing the Swiss diplomatic office from Pyongyang in a few days and take a relevant measure.”

In October, North Korea hosted the Swiss Foreign Minister and the two sides agreed to promote dialogue and cooperation. Switzerland also recently opened a diplomatic office in Pyongyang.

North Korea has dramatically advanced ties with Russia since 2023 and is believed to have shipped weapons and troops to help Moscow in the war against Ukraine under a comprehensive partnership treaty their leaders signed in 2024. REUTERS
summary: North Korea considers shutting Swiss diplomatic office in Pyongyang after sanctions over children’s camp, KCNA says Read more at straitstimes.com.
